faqItems.question: How do I get paid?
faqItems.answer: Your earnings are added to your in-app wallet after each completed delivery. Cash out any time to your registered bKash / Nagad / bank account — transfers arrive within 2 hours during business hours, or by the next morning outside business hours.

faqItems.question: What if the customer isn't available at the drop-off?
faqItems.answer: Wait at the location for 5 minutes, then try calling the customer. If you still can't reach them, mark the order as 'Customer not reachable' from the trip screen and return the order to the restaurant — your full base fare is still credited.

faqItems.question: Can I cancel an accepted trip?
faqItems.answer: You can decline a request before pickup without penalty. After pickup, contact rider support immediately — repeated cancellations after pickup affect your acceptance rate and may trigger a temporary review.

faqItems.question: How are incentive bonuses calculated?
faqItems.answer: Peak-hour incentives (10× — 12× weekday and 6 PM — 9 PM weekends) and distance bonuses are added on top of your base fare. The 'Today's Summary' card shows how much you've earned in incentives today.

faqItems.question: What documents do I need to ride?
faqItems.answer: A valid driving license (bike / car) or NID for bicycle riders, plus a vehicle registration card. Keep the originals accessible — KhaiDai may request verification photos before your weekly payout is released.

faqItems.question: How do I update my vehicle or payout details?
faqItems.answer: Open Settings → Vehicle & Payout. Changes to your payout method take effect for the next withdrawal. Vehicle changes require re-uploading your registration card and may trigger a short verification window.

about.title: Bringing the best of your neighbourhood straight to your door.
about.intro: KhaiDai started in 2025 with one simple belief — eating well should be as easy as tapping a button. We partner with the city's most loved restaurants and the riders who keep Dhaka moving, so every meal arrives hot, fresh, and on time.
about.missionBody: Make great food accessible to every household in Bangladesh — affordably, reliably, and with the local flavour people grew up with.
about.valuesBody: Honest pricing for restaurants, fair earnings for riders, and consistently good meals for customers. No shortcuts.
about.visionBody: From a single Dhaka ward to every district — more restaurants, smarter routes, and the same promise in every pin code.
about.storyBody: The idea for KhaiDai was born out of a very Bangladeshi frustration: ordering biryani at 9 PM and getting it cold, or not getting it at all. We thought — what if the technology behind the order actually worked for the kitchen and the rider, not just the customer? Today KhaiDai partners with hundreds of restaurants across the city and supports thousands of riders earning a steady income on flexible hours.
about.storyClosing: We're still early. But every order, every review, and every rider who joins brings us closer to the version of food delivery we always wanted.
